SequentialCommandGroup runs a list of commands one after another.

Each command must finish before the next one starts.

This solves the problem you saw in the WaitCommand lesson — where all commands ran at once.

Declare a private DcMotor field.

In initialize(), get "front_left_motor" from hardwareMap.

steps.title: Build a sequence with InstantCommand and WaitCommand
Sequencing is the backbone of auton

content.value:
This is how autonomous routines are built.

Small commands for each action, chained in a SequentialCommandGroup. Each command waits for the previous to finish.

You can chain InstantCommands and WaitCommands to build any timed sequence, and later use decorators like withTimeout() to add even more control.
